stem:
Xylem and phloem are the transport tissues of plants. Both tissues have more than one cell type.

The conducting cells of xylem contain xylem sap and those of phloem contain phloem sap. The composition of xylem sap differs from the composition of phloem sap.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
The main component of xylem sap and phloem sap is water.

Explain why water is the main component of xylem sap and phloem sap.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Three types of cell associated with the translocation of sucrose are:

- companion cell
- mesophyll cell
- phloem sieve tube element.

**A**, **B** and **C** are three events that occur at the source. Each event refers to '**the cell**' but does not name the type of cell concerned.

**A** Sucrose moves through plasmodesmata into **the cell**.
**B** Hydrogen ions are transported out of **the cell**.
**C** Sucrose moves into **the cell** through cotransporter proteins.

Complete Table 6.1 by matching the event with a correct cell type.

Each cell type may be identified once, more than once, or not at all.
